provenance: Executed unchanged deterministic banking tool/service source with synthetic in-memory accounts and mocked SUCCESS executor setting. ADK/provider startup and .env loading were omitted; ToolContext is a lightweight fixture and approval lifetime is the code default of 24 hours. This verifies these function paths only, not model behavior, live banking, production concurrency, or cross-process state.
